Events & Impact Stories

Detailed reports of completed field activities in Biougra and surrounding forgotten villages, featuring multi-day timelines and contributing team members.

School Refurbishment
2026-07-15
Douar Aït Yassin, Biougra Region

School Refurbishment & Supplies Mission at Douar Aït Yassin

Volunteers sanded walls, repaired damaged ceilings, painted vibrant educational murals, and provided 120 backpacks loaded with notebooks, pens, and art materials.

120 Students Equipped • 4 Classrooms Fully Restored

Food Package Distribution
2026-06-28
Highland Villages near Biougra

Essential Food Package & Soap Distribution Drive

Delivered customized packages containing high-grade flour, cooking oil, tea, sugar, and hygiene soaps to 85 families based on prior village census data.

85 Families Supported • 420+ Individuals Nourished
Contributing Team:

Spring of Life Well Drilling
2026-05-10
Village Tizi, Biougra District

Spring of Life: Well Drilling bringing Water to Village Inhabitants

Under the banner 'Spring of Life', our association consulted hydrology experts, selected the optimal location, and drilled a 110-meter deep water well.

110-Meter Well Drilled • Daily Clean Water for 350+ Villagers
